data.title: The Fall of the Berlin Wall
sentences: The Berlin Wall stood for twenty-eight years as the physical embodiment of the Iron Curtain.
By 1989, mounting civil unrest across East Germany reached a breaking point.
On November 9, government official Günter Schabowski mistakenly announced that travel restrictions were lifted immediately.
Thousands of East Berliners surged toward the border crossings, overwhelming the guards.
Without orders to use force, the overwhelmed soldiers eventually opened the gates.
Citizens from both sides climbed the concrete barrier, celebrating with hammers and chisels.
The collapse of the wall signaled the symbolic end of the Cold War.
Within one year, the division between East and West Germany was officially dismantled.
The reunification of the country followed in October 1990.
This historic event reshaped the geopolitical landscape of Europe forever.
